title: C2DTA Smartwatch (simulated wearable)
description: Simulated smartwatch publishing heart rate and geolocation telemetry at 1.0 msg/s nominal over MQTT with TLS (QoS 1). Payloads conform to the JSON Schema https://c2dta.org/egw/schemas/smartwatch-v1.schema.json (envelope + measurement fields, CONTRACTS.md sections 2-3). The placeholder {{EGW_HOST}} is substituted at deployment time with the broker host (env EGW_MQTT_HOST); {egw_id} and {device_uuid} are URI variables declared in uriVariables. The Ditto twin of a device instance is org.c2dta:{device_uuid} (CONTRACTS.md section 4).

basic_sc.description: MQTT username/password over TLS (Mosquitto password_file; anonymous access forbidden; CONTRACTS.md section 1).

egw_id.description: Edge gateway identifier (env EGW_ID, default egw-01; CONTRACTS.md section 2).

device_uuid.description: Stable UUID v4 of the simulated device instance (CONTRACTS.md section 2).

heart_rate_bpm.title: Heart rate
heart_rate_bpm.description: Instantaneous heart rate in beats per minute.

telemetry.title: Telemetry event
telemetry.description: Complete telemetry payload (common envelope + heart_rate_bpm, lat, lon) published by the device with MQTT QoS 1 on topic c2dt/{egw_id}/{device_uuid}/telemetry. Validated by the controller against the JSON Schema referenced in links (rel schema) before any Ditto update.

data.description: JSON object conforming to https://c2dta.org/egw/schemas/smartwatch-v1.schema.json (draft 2020-12, unevaluatedProperties false).
